caption: The drawing shows two rectangular wooden blocks positioned side by side. Each block has a raised decorative border featuring a pattern of leaves and small stars, forming a frame around the central area. Inside each frame is a single, prominent, stylized letter: the left block displays the letter "T" and the right block displays the letter "S." The blocks are rendered in shades of brown, with darker tones used to highlight the carved details and shadows. The overall composition is simple, with the objects centered on a plain, light beige background. The artist's name, "FRANKLIN SYRES," is written in small capital letters below the blocks, slightly to the right.
title: Butter Mold
